mapper.sql: SELECT w.id, w.grade_id, g.name AS grade_name, w.effective_from, w.hourly_wage, w.note, w.created_by, u.name AS created_by_name, w.created_at FROM grade_hourly_wages w JOIN emp_grades g ON g.id = w.grade_id LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = w.created_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO grade_hourly_wages(grade_id, effective_from, hourly_wage, note, created_by) VALUES(#{gradeId}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{hourlyWage}, #{note}, #{createdBy}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE hourly_wage = VALUES(hourly_wage), note = VALUES(note), created_by = VALUES(created_by), created_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO grade_hourly_wage_logs(grade_id, grade_name, action, effective_from, hourly_wage, actor_id, actor_name) VALUES(#{gradeId}, #{gradeName}, #{action}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{hourlyWage}, #{actorId}, #{actorName})
